title: SolutionInput
description: Composite input for the solution (strategy) layer. Each artifact may be supplied either as a Canonical Contract envelope ({"payload": ...}) or as the raw legacy dict. Deliberately permissive: the authoritative shapes live in contracts/, and the upstream skills' own eval suites guarantee their internal shape. This schema guards the COMPOSITION (which artifacts are required), not their internals.

coverage_gap_analysis.description: CoverageGapAnalysis — authoritative driver. Each gap needs gap_id / domain / current_coverage.status / gap_level.

requirement_analysis.description: RequirementAnalysis — supplies constraints (stated priorities, analysis boundary, analysis_status).

risk_assessment.description: RiskAssessment — referenced only (traceability). Never recomputed here.

client_profile.description: ClientProfile — accepted for traceability; not required by the strategy layer.
